plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Interdisciplinary-Arts-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 9/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. The map's title block prints only 'Interdisciplinary Arts'; the BA is the degree in the official UW Bothell degree list for this program. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map, so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Disclosed as printed: unlike the companion IAS maps, this map prints NO minimum-grade parenthetical on BIS 300 or BIS 499 (no '(min 2.0)' / '(min 2.5)'), and it prints no course titles for BIS 300, BISIA 319 or BIS 499; they are recorded as 'no title printed on the degree map' rather than sourced elsewhere. On this map the credit-rule sentence and the time-schedule sentence run together in print. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major'; the star means 'see list of choices' — those lists are not printed on the map, so star-marked slots list no options; the four-point marker means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'. No GPA/application note and no per-year note is printed on this map. Generic and category slots are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots with unique synthetic codes.
